anya (eng): Postmortem uploaded — root cause: synchronized token TTL renewals + model-reg metadata batch -> vendor auth throttled. Impact: ~9m elevated errors. https://redwood.in/postmortems/1999990000
max (sre): Timeline shows auth 429s at 02:14 UTC. KV cache misses amplified calls.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor ticket VEND-33001 opened. They want a 60s trace and client QPS numbers.
maria (security): Action: stagger rotations and add jitter. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-04-04.
anya (eng): Short-term: single-flight token refresh + local cache. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-03-26.
max (sre): Add circuit-breaker on auth calls + alert when auth 429/5xx > 3% for 3m. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-27.
leo (vendor-relations): Propose vendor-assisted dry-run (15m) to validate fallbacks. I'll coordinate legal and vendor windows.
prakash (product): Add incident tag 'vendor-auth-blast' and include in monthly risk digest. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-30.
slo-bot: Incident summary: duration 9m, peak auth failure 81%, hosted-api SLO impact 0.02%.
anya (eng): I'll attach a safe curl snippet and export a 1-min trace to the postmortem doc.
max (sre): Ops checklist draft incoming. Will own action tracker.
anya (eng): End of thread.
